title: Data import
subtitle: Import historical data from external sources into DriveChronik.

tessie.title: Tessie
tessie.description: Import historical driving and charging data from a Tessie raw data export.
tessie.details: Select the four CSV files from the Tessie raw data export. DriveChronik checks the files before the import starts. Existing TeslaMate periods are protected.
tessie.ready: All four Tessie files were uploaded and checked successfully.

errors.filesMissing: Please select all four Tessie files.
errors.serverFilesMissing: The uploaded files are incomplete on the server.
errors.invalidJob: The import job could not be created.
errors.unknown: An unknown error occurred during the Tessie import.

teslaCharging.title: Tesla Supercharger
teslaCharging.description: Import Tesla charging history from the Tesla app CSV export and match it to existing charging sessions.
teslaCharging.details: DriveChronik checks VIN, charging start time, energy and location. The import does not overwrite manually maintained charging costs.
teslaCharging.fileHint: CSV export from Tesla app → Charging → History
teslaCharging.completed: {total} Tesla records imported · {matched} matched to charging sessions.
teslaCharging.reviewHint: Some entries could not be matched unambiguously. They are still archived and can be matched again later.
teslaCharging.previewTruncated: The preview shows at most 100 entries. All records are processed during import.

errors.unknown: The Tesla CSV could not be processed.

tronityCharging.title: TRONITY charging
tronityCharging.description: Import charging sessions from a TRONITY XLSX export and match them to existing DriveChronik charging sessions.
tronityCharging.details: DriveChronik checks start and end times, energy and location. Existing TeslaMate or Tessie charging sessions are enriched instead of duplicated. Manual costs, notes and locked places remain protected.
tronityCharging.reviewHint: {count} ambiguous charging sessions will not be changed automatically for safety.
tronityCharging.previewTruncated: The preview shows at most 100 charging sessions. All records are processed during import.
tronityCharging.completed: Import completed · {inserted} new · {updated} enriched · {unchanged} unchanged · {skipped} ambiguous skipped.

actions.newRecord: Will be created as a new charging session.
actions.skipped: Will not be changed automatically during import.
actions.noChange: Existing charging session is already complete.

errors.noVehicles: No vehicle is available in DriveChronik for the TRONITY import.
errors.unknown: The TRONITY XLSX export could not be processed.

history.title: Import history
history.description: The most recent data imports and their current rollback status.
history.empty: No tracked imports are available yet.
history.previewDelete: {count, plural, one {# record will be removed.} other {# records will be removed.}}
history.previewRestore: {count, plural, one {# record will be restored.} other {# records will be restored.}}
history.previewAlready: {count, plural, one {# change is already rolled back.} other {# changes are already rolled back.}}
history.previewConflicts: {count, plural, one {# conflict: subsequently changed or linked data remains protected.} other {# conflicts: subsequently changed or linked data remains protected.}}
history.previewNothing: There are no changes to roll back for this import.
history.rollbackDone: The import was rolled back completely.
history.rollbackPartial: Rollback partially completed. {count, plural, one {# conflict remains protected.} other {# conflicts remain protected.}}

errors.preview: The rollback preview could not be loaded.
errors.rollback: The import could not be rolled back.
